lines.speaker: npc_baba_landlord
lines.text: Ah, my young tenant! I hope your hustle is moving well today. Don't forget that this compound runs on discipline and punctuality.

options.label: Pay compound respect and ask about the compound rules
Ask about the upcoming rent schedule

lines.speaker: npc_baba_landlord
lines.text: Rent is not something that waits for rain or sunshine! 25,000 Naira by month-end keeps the caretaker smiling and the padlocks off the gate.

options.label: Promise him timely payment with polite assurances

lines.speaker: npc_baba_landlord
lines.text: Rule number one: no generator fumes pointed at Mama Caro's window. Rule number two: switch off by 11:00 PM prompt so working people can sleep!

options.label: Nod in full agreement with compound peace

lines.speaker: npc_mama_nkechi
lines.text: Welcome, my pikin! You look like someone that has been fighting Lagos sun since 6:00 AM. Come sit down, eat hot amala or jollof!

options.label: Ask for the latest neighbourhood market gist
Ask for trade advice on hungry morning commuters

lines.speaker: npc_mama_nkechi
lines.text: They say new container loads arrived at the wholesale depot this morning. If you have cash ready, buy early before prices climb by afternoon!

options.label: Thank her warmly for the golden insider tip

lines.speaker: npc_mama_nkechi
lines.text: A hungry man has no patience to negotiate. When people come from transit, serve them fast, smile, and make your portion look full. They will always return!

options.label: Commit her golden rule of hospitality to memory

lines.speaker: npc_chairman_goke
lines.text: Oshodi moves because we keep order in the loading bays. Whether you are driving danfo or hawking goods, respect the queue and pay your union dues.

options.label: Inquire about commercial transit route conditions
Ask how union dues support local park security

lines.speaker: npc_chairman_goke
lines.text: The Mile 2 corridor is heavy in the evening, but the turnover is double. If your fuel tank has enough and your tyres are firm, that is where the real money sleeps.

options.label: Salute his park experience respectfully

lines.speaker: npc_chairman_goke
lines.text: Five hundred naira ticket covers task force clearance, tyre pump access, and security against midnight scavengers. Pay clean and drive with your head high.

options.label: Acknowledge the value of park protection

lines.speaker: npc_officer_ade
lines.text: Good day! My mandate on this expressway is simple: free-flowing traffic and road safety. Keep your vehicle roadworthy and pick passengers inside designated bus bays.

options.label: Ask about traffic compliance and inspection standards
Ask how to navigate corridor roadblocks during rush hours

lines.speaker: npc_officer_ade
lines.text: Move with caution. We want everyone to return safely to their families at night.

options.label: Greet the officer with formal respect

lines.speaker: npc_officer_ade
lines.text: Make sure your side mirrors are intact and your vehicle papers are valid. When a driver respects the law, no enforcement officer will bother them.

options.label: Thank him for the clear professional guidance

lines.speaker: npc_officer_ade
lines.text: Never drive against traffic (one-way). No shortcut is worth impoundment and fines. Patience is the cheapest fuel in Lagos.

options.label: Take the wisdom to heart

lines.speaker: npc_chidi_spare_parts
lines.text: Nna, welcome! Quality phone chargers, car adaptors, power banks, and fan belts. Straight from genuine suppliers, no counterfeit talk here!

options.label: Ask for the secret to spotting fake accessories
Inquire about upcoming Ladipo wholesale consignments

lines.speaker: npc_chidi_spare_parts
lines.text: Feel the copper weight in the cable. Cheap aluminium fakes feel like feathers. And always inspect the holographic seal under daylight.

options.label: Thank Brother Chidi for the trade secret

lines.speaker: npc_chidi_spare_parts
lines.text: Power banks sell like pure water whenever the national grid drops. Stock up on phone accessories before the evening rush!

options.label: Note the commercial opportunity

lines.speaker: npc_sister_grace
lines.text: Good day my friend! Joy and peace to your hustle today. In this bustling city, we must never lose our compassion for one another.

options.label: Request an uplifting community prayer blessing
Ask how the local welfare outreach is assisting elders

lines.speaker: npc_sister_grace
lines.text: May your steps be ordered today. May your pockets not run dry, and may favour meet you in every street corner of Oshodi!

options.label: Say a heartfelt Amen

lines.speaker: npc_sister_grace
lines.text: We organize evening literacy classes and medicine support for retired market elders. When our neighbours thrive, the whole community is secure.

options.label: Praise the welfare group's dedication

lines.speaker: npc_alabi_mechanic
lines.text: Tools don't lie, my brother. If an engine is coughing, don't force it: listen to the piston rings and check your oil gauge.

options.label: Ask for engine maintenance tips to prevent breakdowns
Ask how to tune generator carburettors for fuel economy

lines.speaker: npc_alabi_mechanic
lines.text: Never mix contaminated roadside petrol into your tank. It gums the carburetor needles and leaves you stranded on the flyover bridge.

options.label: Thank Master Alabi for the mechanical wisdom

lines.speaker: npc_alabi_mechanic
lines.text: A quarter turn on the idle air screw leans out the fuel mixture. You save two litres every evening without losing power.

options.label: Remember the fuel saving adjustment

lines.speaker: npc_kemi_pos
lines.text: Cash in, cash out, utility tokens! Fast network, receipt guaranteed. What transaction are we handling for you today?

options.label: Ask about daily terminal cashflow patterns
Ask what street news commuters are discussing today

lines.speaker: npc_kemi_pos
lines.text: Morning commuters withdraw exact 500 and 1,000 naira bills for transit fare. Evening crowd deposits trade profits. Timing is everything in liquidity.

options.label: Appreciate her financial insight

lines.speaker: npc_kemi_pos
lines.text: Bank networks have been smooth all morning, but keep cash on hand just in case clouds gather by evening!

options.label: Thank Kemi for the update
